description:
Implement the reference generator and parity-check materialization for canonical BCH codes with the compact-by-default access behavior: matrices are materialized only on request, into caller-provided buffers where asked, with caching an explicit opt-in.

## Background

The current BCH implementation caches its first computed `BitMatrix` unconditionally behind a mutex; the old cache is deleted at cutover. This task owns the correct reference materialization from the canonical construction model — packed binary and field-generic over `FieldMatrix` — while the later optimization task speeds up this same implementation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Canonical BCH codes materialize generator and parity-check matrices from the construction model, packed binary and field-generic, correct against direct polynomial-derived references.
- [hard] REQ-02: Access provides allocating and caller-buffer paths without implicit caching; shape mismatches report the coding-general error layer; opt-in caching is explicit and tested in both flows.
title: Reference matrix materialization: compact access, caller buffers, opt-in caching
